issues.legal_issue: A mortgage condition that makes the mortgagee’s interest absolute upon notice of re-entry before the agreed redemption period expires is a clog on the equity of redemption.
material_facts: A mortgage deed allowed the mortgagor four years to repay the debt and redeem the property.
The deed provided that if the mortgagor received a notice of re-entry before that period expired, the transfer to the mortgagee would become absolute.
A notice of re-entry was served during the four-year period, and the mortgagee claimed ownership under the condition.
The mortgagor brought a suit for redemption, and the mortgagee relied on the condition to resist redemption.
The condition appeared in the mortgage deed and concerned the interest transferred by the mortgage.
issues.conclusion: The condition was a term of the mortgage transaction and was void as a clog on the equity of redemption; the mortgagor’s right to redeem was not extinguished by the notice.
issues.legal_principle: A mortgage term that takes away the mortgagor’s right to redeem while the mortgage subsists is a clog on the equity of redemption. A condition in the mortgage deed that makes the transfer absolute on a specified event during the agreed redemption period is part of the mortgage transaction, not an independent arrangement. The judgment relies on the equitable principle protecting the right of redemption and cites no statutory provision or earlier case.

predicates.mortgage_redemption_dispute: The court is deciding a dispute in which a mortgagor seeks to redeem mortgaged property.
predicates.mortgagor_has_unexpired_redemption_perio: The mortgagor still has time under the mortgage arrangement to repay the debt and redeem the property.
predicates.mortgage_condition_makes_transfer_absolu: The mortgage arrangement provides that notice of an external event during the redemption period makes the transfer to the mortgagee absolute.
predicates.mortgagee_claims_ownership_under_conditi: The mortgagee relies on that condition to claim ownership instead of allowing redemption.

issues.definition: When a redemption dispute involves an unexpired redemption period and the mortgagee claims ownership under a condition that makes the transfer absolute upon notice during that period, the condition is void as a clog on redemption.
